name: browser_session
description: Trusted local browser session tool for agent-owned Chrome/Edge automation. Opens visible or headless browser sessions with a fresh profile, navigates URLs/files, clicks, types, evaluates JavaScript, captures screenshots, inspects DOM/text/layout, reports status, and closes only the owned session.

artifact_contracts.name: session_state
artifact_contracts.description: Owned browser session state for follow-up actions.

action.description: One of: open, goto, screenshot, inspect, click, type, evaluate, status, close, close_all.

session_id.description: Stable agent-local session id. Defaults to default.

url.description: http(s), file://, or existing absolute/relative HTML/file path for open/goto.

html_path.description: Existing local HTML path for open/goto when url is not provided.

headless.description: Run headless when true. Defaults to false so UI agents can inspect visible browser behavior.

text.description: Text to type into the focused element or selector.

expression.description: JavaScript expression for evaluate action. Executed in the current page context.

wait_ms.description: Small wait after navigation/action before capture or inspection.

remove_profile.description: When closing, remove the temporary browser profile directory. Defaults to true.
